audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] and whys[1] were shifted one stage: the Level 1 row described levels 2-3 and the Level 2 row claimed 'a full three-turret nest'.
audit.why: Heimerdinger has one H-28G charge at level 1 and two at level 2. Ambessa at level 1 has only Cunning Sweep, 650 range on a 14s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Level 1 now reads as the conceded contact window; Level 2 as the second turret zoning her off CS against a 14s Cunning Sweep.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 text said Ambessa's 'sustain outlasts my chip' and the item block prescribed anti-heal against 'his healing'.
audit.why: Riot's Public Execution text describes a blink to 1250, a suppression on arrival and a stun on the slam — no healing. The kit's heal flag is a tooltip-parse misfire; nothing in Ambessa's descriptions heals. Zhonya's, not Grievous Wounds, is the level-6 answer.
audit.corrected: Level 6 rewritten around the 1250-range blink, the suppression and the stun, with CH-2's flat 11s as the discipline check and Zhonya's as the item answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ambessa's passive was called 'Repeating Dashes' across roughly twenty fields; Heimerdinger's grenade was called 'CH-3X' and once 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade'; turret beams were said to slow; Repudiation was never mentioned; wants.you[1] said 'Drakehound's Steps'.
audit.why: Her passive is Drakehound's Step. Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, 11s flat, 970 range, stunning only a direct hit and slowing around it — the turret's secondary attack is a pass-through beam with no slow. Repudiation (18/17/16/15/14s) gives her a shield and grounds the area, so it eats the front of your burst.
audit.corrected: Real names throughout; bleed the Repudiation shield before spending CH-2, and stun on the direct hit as she dashes in rather than relying on the ring slow.

edits.after: At level 1 I have one turret and no stun, and Cunning Sweep is 650 range on a 14s cooldown — neither of us can punish, so I place the cannon safely behind the wave and concede contact.

edits.before: A full three-turret nest plus the slow beams holds the lane; her dash combo isn't online enough to force a fight through three charging beams yet, so I keep her starved.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are my strongest stretch: three turret charges plus the CH-3X Lightning Grenade make any all-in suicidal — she dashes in, I center-stun her, and three slowing beams plus a W barrage shred her while she's locked. Force the trades here while I out-zone her. Level 6 is where it slips: Public Execution lets her dash onto me, suppress, and recast to execute, while her chain CC keeps me pinned off the turrets and her sustain outlasts my chip before the buildings can answer. The whole 6 fight is her grenade discipline versus mine — if my E is up when she ults, I can center-stun her mid-dive; if it's down, I'm dead, so never burn the grenade before she commits.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are my strongest stretch: three turret charges plus the CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade make any all-in suicidal — she dashes in, I stun her on the direct hit, and three beams plus a W barrage shred her while she's locked. Force the trades here while I out-zone her, and bleed her Repudiation shield before I spend the grenade. Level 6 is where it slips: Public Execution reaches 1250, suppresses on arrival and stuns on the slam, while her chain CC keeps me pinned off the turrets. The whole 6 fight is grenade discipline — CH-2 is a flat 11s, so if it is up when she ults I stun her mid-dive; if it's down, I'm dead.
